name: gap-trap
summary: Agent skill that sets up contracts, gates, ratchets and playbooks so AI-written code must pass checks before merge.
description: An agent skill you run once in a repository: it reads the code, writes the rules that fit that codebase, and adds a gate per rule that fails the commit or CI run when broken. It sets up contracts (the one right way per area such as HTTP, logging, settings, auth), a proven-red CI job that fails when a new test also passes on old code, ratchets that may only go down, and playbooks of hard-won facts; git and the agent cannot skip a gate.
contains: installs contracts, a proven-red CI job, ratchets and playbooks into a repo
gates run inside Node and Python test suites; other languages get shell gates (git, grep, awk)
installed with the skills CLI or by hand into ~/.claude/skills or ~/.agents/skills
runs on the harness's top coding model and stops on anything smaller
derived from the framework zmNinjaNg runs on; MIT license
